acceptance.expect: no code path returns performed=true without evidence it acted
acceptance.why: a convincing no-op is the failure mode this whole program exists to stop

forbidden: The adapter must not be able to trigger a production deployment.
No credentials in the repository. Read them from the environment.
objective: Every capability currently defaults to an adapter that performs nothing and says so. Deployment is the first to wire because BENCH-02 already gives it a failing case and a passing one.
reconciliation_note: Same hold as T-001. Wiring a deployment adapter is a deployment architecture change and it presumes an orchestrator placement that is not yet decided.
report: The adapter interface you implemented and what it reads.
steps: Implement a DeploymentAdapter that reads real state: the commit sha, whether it is an ancestor of main, whether a build artifact exists at the declared output path.
It reads. It does not deploy. Promotion is irreversible and the rules already escalate it, so an adapter that can deploy without a person is a defect regardless of what the rules say afterwards.
Add a test proving the adapter returns performed=false when it cannot reach the platform, rather than raising or reporting success.
title: Wire the deployment adapter
